== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3077]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The 1661 St Cuthbert's James Glesgow index is accounted in father findings as a child of James Glasgow and Annapill Glessie. The uncommon Annapill Glessie pairing and St Cuthbert’s family sequence match the selected adult James.

Confident for the recorded James/Annapill household; it does not prove that Helen Clerk was the same man’s earlier wife.

Next useful test: Keep the full couple and parish attached to any later adult identification.
